name: The Dark Valley
description:
Legend has it that the moon once had a face.
Under the fierce moon's face, like a white bow, the paths through the forest labyrinth would bring lost people to jade and amber dreams. This forest labyrinth has ceased to exist for hundreds of years — and yet even a hundred thousand winters must seem like a day in the garden of dreams.

tabs.name: The Spirit Tree's Hall
tabs.description: This domain was occupied by desert bandits from who-knows-where. Perhaps they must have some unknown treasure on hand.
